title: Budget
description: A government's fiscal plan for one period, at one phase of the budget cycle. Mirrors the Fiscal Data Package, which remains the source model; this is a schema.org projection for discovery and for joining budgets to the organization, meeting, and legislation that produced them. schema.org has no budget, fiscal, expenditure, or appropriation concept of any kind - MonetaryAmount is a value type, not a model - so gs:Budget is minted outright.

name.description: The budget document's title, e.g. 'Example City FY2026 Adopted Budget'.

description.description: A plain-language summary of this budget, when the name alone isn't enough.

url.description: Where this budget's canonical human-readable page lives.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this budget beyond its `@id`.

budgetPhase.description: Which point in the budget cycle this document represents. Required, and the single most important field here: a budget figure without its phase is not comparable to any other figure.

fiscalYear.description: The publisher's own label for the period, e.g. 'FY2026' or '2026-27'. A label only - startDate and endDate carry the actual period, because fiscal years begin in different months in different countries.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Required: an amount without a currency is unusable outside its own country, and this profile is used across countries.

totalAmount.description: Sum across the budget, for validation against the lines.

adoptedBy.description: The body that adopted it, usually the legislature.

enactedAt.description: The Meeting at which it was adopted. Joins to the meetings profile.

legislation.description: The appropriation ordinance or act giving it legal force. Joins to the code profile.

budgetLine.description: The `BudgetLine`s that make up this budget.

supersedes.description: The earlier phase this revises, e.g. an approved budget superseding the proposed one. Retain both: comparing phases is most of what budget transparency is for.

conformanceLevel.description: schemaGov conformance level claimed, per SPEC section 4. Distinct from conformsTo, which names an external standard the data follows.

distribution.description: schema:DataDownload. Publish the Fiscal Data Package itself here; this projection is for discovery, not a replacement for it.

dateModified.description: When this record was last updated.

inLanguage.description: The language(s) this budget document is published in.

license.description: The licence this budget data is published under.

sourceDataset.description: The `Dataset` this record was published as part of.
